items.title: Janis Siegel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 2015
items.q: Joel gave me one of Joe’s shirts

ctx.x: And he loved Joe Williams. When Joe passed, he was friends with Joe’s widow I believe and Joel gave me one of Joe’s shirts, I think I told you that, which I still have at home.
If I could write you a blank check —
